tasks.short: Plan work assignments and equipment allocations

steps.what: Check operating goals, available workers and equipment condition references
Choose work assignments and equipment allocations for current conditions
Write work assignments and equipment allocations in the shift plan
Check and communicate the final allocation plan to the operating team
Observe whether the allocations meet goals and identify needed changes

tasks.design: Use native context views from {OPS_SYSTEM} and {HCM}, plus recurring rows in the existing shift plan. The supervisor chooses equipment and people, writes actual changes and checks the exact plan communicated through {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate status references and repeated shift-plan entry consume planning time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and reusable plan rows can reduce clerical preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment condition and changing workload can defeat nominal allocations.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor sees practical constraints and adapts the plan.
tasks.altitude: Preserve operational allocation judgement while shortening plan preparation.

reach.learn: Which uncertain status references delay allocation

evidence.claim: Native availability and schedule functions are supported by logistics workforce software; equipment allocation judgement is not established as automated by that capability.
The time saved by views and reusable allocation rows is an unmeasured estimate.

assumptions: The current shift allocation plan is used by the operating team; writing it and communicating it are distinct included steps. No extra monitoring log is added.

Planning staff produce goals, staff declare availability and maintenance staff produce equipment status in existing processes. The supervisor checks freshness and contacts the producer for missing status in s1;17 retained hours include that work. No machine-ready condition flag is assumed.

The context view removes three of20 navigation hours. Recurring allocation rows remove7.5 of25 entry hours;17.5 hours remain for actual allocation changes, conflict checks and ordinary saves without self-approval.
No automated personnel scoring, allocation, alert or distribution is proposed.
unknowns: Whether equipment status is current enough to reuse
How often plans share recurring rows
research_questions: What entry time remains on shifts with equipment substitutions?

already_counted.description: Context checking and allocation entry remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: Supervisor maintains recurring rows after operating changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact shift/date, worker duties, equipment identities and recipients checked before communicating; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89.5, gross10.5 less upkeep1 gives net9.5. Low2 retains20 context hours and22 entry hours because uncertain equipment status defeats the view and most rows change, plus55 other hours: R97, net2. High6.5 retains18 context and19.5 entry hours with partly recurring allocations, plus55 other hours: R92.5, net6.5. Central retains17 context and17.5 entry hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Demonstrate work tasks and assign experienced trainers

steps.what: Find the current work task procedure and local training references
Choose suitable training tasks and experienced workers to teach them
Write the training assignment in the existing work plan
Check and communicate the training assignment to the experienced worker
Explain and demonstrate work tasks to new workers
Observe practice and correct misunderstandings or unsafe actions

tasks.design: Index current task procedures and reuse the training-assignment section of the existing work plan in {DOCS}. The supervisor chooses the trainer, communicates the assignment through {CHAT}, and explains and observes work personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure navigation and repeated assignment headings add small clerical costs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document navigation and reusable work-plan fields remove only that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching and supervision depend on the new worker and actual equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor notices unsafe misunderstanding during practice.
tasks.altitude: Reduce small preparation costs without replacing practical instruction.

reach.learn: Which novice needs require direct supervisor involvement

evidence.claim: Native procedure indexes and reusable assignment fields may shorten clerical preparation; no training outcome or local time saving is measured.

assumptions: An existing written training assignment is assumed in the work plan read by the experienced trainer. Where assignments are wholly verbal, that writing step and its saving do not apply; no new completion or competence log is proposed.

The procedure owner supplies current procedures; the supervisor checks applicability in s1 and identifies learner needs and trainer capability in s2. The supervisor produces the actual assignment fields in s3; capture time is retained. Missing references require manual checking.
A topic index removes one of10 reference hours. Reusable assignment headings remove1.5 of10 entry hours, retaining8.5 hours for task-specific writing and ordinary author saves without a gate.
Colleague instruction and communication use internal authority. The gate belongs only to the actual assignment send, not the author's own work-plan save.
unknowns: Whether training assignments are written in the present work plan
research_questions: Is the existing assignment entry repeated clerical work or already a simple verbal instruction?

already_counted.description: Reference checks and actual assignment writing remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: Supervisor keeps assignment headings consistent with current procedures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact learner, trainer, task, procedure revision and timing checked immediately before sending the assignment; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R97.5, gross2.5 less upkeep0.5 gives net2. Low0 retains the existing verbal-assignment process without introducing records or upkeep. High1 retains9.5 reference hours and nine assignment hours plus80 judgement/send/teaching/practice hours: R98.5, less0.5 upkeep. Central requires the existing written assignment and retains nine reference and8.5 entry hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review orders and notices to determine shipping work sequences

steps.what: Collect current orders, schedules, blueprints and shipping or receiving notices
Extract notice dates, material types, volumes and destinations with source references
outputs: draft notice fields with source passages

loop.purpose: Draft fields from inconsistent text notices
loop.input: Current source packet including original notice pages
loop.output: Dates, material types, quantities and destinations with exact source passages
loop.check: Supervisor checks every extracted field and unit against the original and matches each line to its order; no inferred missing values
loop.stop: One draft only; unmatched lines, unreadable pages or missing fields return to manual reading
loop.why_not_simpler: Native structured order fields are reused first; residual notices use varied prose and page layouts that a fixed field map cannot reliably parse

steps.what: Resolve conflicting order versions, drawing details and missing shipping information
inputs: draft notice fields with source passages

steps.what: Determine work sequences, shipping dates and destination priorities
Write the chosen sequence and dates in the existing planning worksheet

tasks.design: Use current source views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}, reusing native structured fields first. A bounded extraction draft handles residual text notices; the supervisor verifies sources, interprets drawings, determines the sequence and writes the existing planning worksheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mixed notice formats require repeated reading and manual transfer of dates and quantities.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order views plus a source-linked extraction draft can reduce clerical reading of routine notices.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing interpretation, conflicts and local sequence trade-offs remain human.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises when a document's literal instruction is operationally inconsistent.
tasks.altitude: Make routine source fields easier to inspect while retaining sequence judgement.

reach.learn: Which missing fields require supervisory investigation

evidence.claim: Source-linked notice extraction with manual matching is a plausible bounded design, not a measured capability or case established by this digest.

assumptions: The task includes the actual planning worksheet used by the supervisor; it does not add a new report, dispatch send or commitment. Staffing allocation is separately priced in the allocation task.

Order and schedule owners produce released versions, engineering produces drawings and shipping staff or counterparties produce notices. The supervisor selects versions in s1; s2 produces proposed structured fields and includes12.5 retained hours of source checking and manual fallback. No free structured address or discrepancy code is assumed.

Native views remove three of20 packet-navigation hours. The bounded draft removes12.5 of25 routine extraction hours while retaining all conflict and drawing interpretation. Existing worksheet defaults remove two of10 repeated-entry hours, with actual decisions and saves retained.
No automated work-sequence decision, ERP write, alert or external send is implied.
unknowns: Share of notices with compatible text and source references
research_questions: Can all extracted dates, quantities and destinations be checked to originals without more review than manual reading?

already_counted.description: Extraction checking and conflict resolution remain in s2 and s3.

incremental.description: Supervisor checks extraction behaviour on changed notice formats.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R82.5, gross17.5 less upkeep2 gives net15.5. Low4 retains20 packet hours,20 extraction hours and nine worksheet hours when most pages are unmatched, plus45 conflict/sequence hours: R94, net4. High10 retains18 packet,17 extraction and eight worksheet hours where only some notice layouts are compatible, plus45 other hours: R88, net10. Central retains17 packet and12.5 extraction hours; no fixed fraction scales the low case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain and verify operational crew records

steps.what: Capture time, materials, expenditure references and crew activity descriptions
outputs: dated operational entries with crew and job identifiers

steps.what: Compare record quantities, hours and expenditures against their source references
inputs: dated operational entries with crew and job identifiers
outputs: draft comparison results and unmatched entries

steps.what: Investigate mismatches and decide the correct operational record values
inputs: draft comparison results and unmatched entries

steps.what: Write the verified corrections and explanations into the operational records

tasks.design: Reuse existing source fields in {HCM}, {OPS_SYSTEM} and {ERP} for a draft comparison view. The supervisor captures missing information, investigates mismatches and writes actual corrections through native record forms; no automatic posting or extra record send is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The supervisor repeatedly compares declarations and documents across separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Stable crew/job identifiers allow deterministic comparison of captured fields.
tasks.still_hard: A recorded quantity can be wrong even when two systems agree.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor verifies what physically happened and resolves conflicting accounts.
tasks.altitude: Spend verification time on mismatches rather than repeated arithmetic.

reach.learn: Which document identifiers fail to match crew records

evidence.claim: Logistics workforce software supports time and attendance records; material and expenditure comparison remains a separate local design.
The proposed comparison labour saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: The task includes original capture and actual correction writing, separate from conversations that establish the facts. No additional report or approval lifecycle is invented.

Staff produce time declarations, stores staff produce material issue documents and purchasing/accounts staff produce expenditure documents in existing work. The supervisor captures crew/job/date, hours, quantities, amounts and activity descriptions in s1 and validates references there;31.5 hours remain. Missing identifiers or documents return to manual checking in s3.

Native defaults remove3.5 of35 repeated-context capture hours, the comparison removes30 manual matching hours, and record forms remove two of10 repeated-reference entry hours. Investigation, actual corrections and ordinary same-system saves remain without author self-approval.
The routine outputs a draft view only; no payroll posting, automatic record correction, notification or external action is implied.
unknowns: Whether present records already reconcile automatically
Compatibility of crew and job identifiers across sources
research_questions: Can each proposed match be traced to the exact declaration or document without introducing new capture work?

already_counted.description: Source capture, mismatch investigation and correction writing remain in s1, s3 and s4.

incremental.description: Supervisor maintains comparison mappings after source-code changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R64.5, gross35.5 less upkeep2 gives net33.5. Low16 retains35 capture,13 manual matching and nine correction hours where job identifiers are often absent, plus25 investigation: R82, net16. High26 retains33 capture, six manual matching and eight correction hours with fewer incompatible references, plus25 investigation: R72, net26. Central retains31.5 capture and eight correction hours with full routine matching; these are source-compatibility cases, not a shared multiplier.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep practical allocation and instruction judgement while reducing clerical planning and record verification.
role.ambitious_version: An operations supervisor who can keep assignments and records current while spending more attention on actual work conditions.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Material-Moving Machine and Vehicle Operators
